[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]In Obsidian, every canonical `created`, `scheduled`, `completion`, [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]calendar label (`today`, `tomorrow`, `Fri`, `Oct 22`) instead of a [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]reading view, embeds, hover previews, Dataview task views, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Tasks query results. The stored Markdown never changes, the cursor [/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]tasks-results: in full-mode Tasks query results, add the same mark to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]each date component through a bounded per-row frame pass. The date-mark [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]post-processor triggers the pass, and it falls back to Tasks' native [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]emoji dates. In short-mode results, CSS swaps the emoji for the glyph. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Extend the tests, contract, README, and manifest, then deploy.[/#D7D7AF]
